text:
Someone warned them. Nobody listened. 🏢📉

Enron hid debt and losses off its balance sheet and was bankrupt by December 2001. Its CEO and CFO went to prison (Jeffrey Skilling's final sentence was 14 years), and its auditor, Arthur Andersen, collapsed too.

The lesson: a warning that isn't acted on isn't a control.

▶️ Watch the full story on our YouTube: https://youtu.be/2YtmTdJJDrM

Education, not financial or legal advice.

#MzansiMoneyMatters #Enron #CorporateGovernance #Business
sources: Video by MMM (shorts). Facts: Enron filed for bankruptcy 2 Dec 2001; CEO Jeffrey Skilling sentenced to 24 years in 2006, reduced to 14 years in 2013; CFO Andrew Fastow imprisoned; Arthur Andersen convicted 2002 and ceased auditing public companies (conviction later overturned 2005).
